parts.name: Rotation Blade
parts.Basic_description: The rotation blade is the sharp cutting component of the folding knife, made of stainless steel for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It performs the cutting function and can rotate or fold into the handle for safety and portability.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around a pivot joint to open or close relative to the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the handle section of the folding knife, typically made of aluminum alloy with ergonomic design and grip inserts.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a secure grip for the user and houses the pivot mechanism for the blade rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main support structure for the rotating blade.
